name: Caramel Latte
caffeineNote: Raposa's product page states 150 mg of caffeine
summary: Raposa's nitro cold brew with oat milk and caramel syrup, from the brand's own site and not yet checked against a can: 150 mg of caffeine and 110 calories in a 250 mL (8.45 oz) can. Raposa lists cold brew at 60.3% of the can, oat beverage at 31.16% and caramel syrup at 5.65%, then sugar and inulin; it publishes no sugar or protein figures.
